channel.title: AI on Akshat Gupta
channel.description: Recent content in AI on Akshat Gupta

item.title: Fairness in Machine Learning
item.description: An exploration of fairness in ML systems — defining group, individual, and causal fairness, sources of algorithmic bias, and techniques to address them.

item.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence Workshop in Ujjain
What is an Ontology in a Knowledge Graph?
item.description: A clear explanation of ontologies in AI — the formal schemas that give knowledge graphs their meaning and enable structured machine reasoning.

item.title: LLM Fine-Tuning and LoRA: Making Large Models Work for You
item.description: How to fine-tune large language models efficiently using LoRA — low-rank adaptation that dramatically reduces compute and memory requirements.

item.title: What Are Knowledge Graphs?
item.description: A plain-language introduction to knowledge graphs — how they represent real-world entities and relationships, and why they're central to modern AI and search systems.

item.title: Prompt Engineering: The Art of Talking to AI
item.description: A practical guide to prompt engineering — the art of crafting effective prompts for LLMs, covering zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and advanced techniques.

item.title: Evaluating LLMs: How Do You Measure a Model's Mind?
item.description: A practical guide to evaluating large language models — benchmarks, automated metrics, human evaluation, and the pitfalls of measuring model quality.

item.title: RAG and LLMs: Teaching Large Models to Use External Knowledge
item.description: A technical introduction to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) — combining LLMs with external knowledge bases for accurate, up-to-date responses.

item.title: Understanding Attention in Transformers: The Core of Modern NLP
item.description: A deep dive into self-attention mechanisms — how they work, why they power modern Transformers, and the different attention variants used in GPT, BERT, and LLaMA.

item.title: Model Extraction Attacks: How Hackers Steal AI Models
item.description: An in-depth look at model extraction attacks — how adversaries replicate ML models through repeated queries, and practical defenses against theft.

item.title: Memories in Large Language Models: How AI Models Remember and Retrieve
item.description: How LLMs manage memory across three time scales — context windows, KV caches, and RAG-based long-term retrieval — and what this means for building AI systems.

item.title: Speaker Anonymization: Protecting Voice Identity in the AI Era
item.description: A deep dive into speaker anonymization — protecting voice identity using voice conversion, signal processing, and deep learning while preserving speech intelligibility.

item.title: LLM Agents: Building AI Systems That Can Reason and Act
item.description: A comprehensive guide to LLM agents — autonomous AI systems that reason, plan, and act. Covers architecture, memory, tool use, and real-world implementation.
